sentences.en: I was unwilling for my wife to accept the invitation.
sentences.zh: 我不愿意让我的妻子接受那个邀请。

sentences.en: I had to decline the invitation because I was ill.
sentences.zh: 因为我生病了，我不得不拒绝这个邀请。

sentences.en: Today, we received your invitation to the exhibition with pleasure.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴收到了你寄来的展览请柬。
